snippet.title: PlayStation - Saber Marionette J - Battle Sabers (1997)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Saber Marionette J: Battle Sabers is an Action game, developed by Tom Create and published by Bandai Visual, which was released in Japan in 1997.
